future_ui_decision: Keep raw production probabilities pending stronger calibration evidence.

isotonic_status.reason: Skipped prospectively because each training CV calibration fold has limited per-class support; non-parametric isotonic calibration is prone to overfitting with small calibration samples.

limitations: Calibration does not turn model output into agricultural-success probability.
The comparison applies only to this dataset and fixed held-out split.
Top-label ECE combines classes and can hide crop-specific calibration patterns.

reliability_methodology.calibration_training: 5-fold stratified CV inside the 1,760-row training partition
reliability_methodology.confidence: maximum predicted class probability per sample
reliability_methodology.ece: count-weighted absolute difference between bin accuracy and confidence
reliability_methodology.outcome: whether the top predicted label is correct
